import os, sys
sys.path.insert(0, os.getcwd())
from src.money import parse_amount, format_amount
from src.api import make_invoice
assert format_amount(parse_amount("12.50")) == "12.50"
assert make_invoice(["1.20", "2.30"]) == {"total": "3.50", "count": 2}
assert make_invoice([]) == {"total": "0.00", "count": 0}
from decimal import Decimal
import decimal
def bad(v):
    try: parse_amount(v)
    except ValueError: return
    raise AssertionError(v)
for v in [1.5, True, None, b"1", "1e2", " 1", "1 ", "0", "-1", "+0.00", "NaN", "Infinity", Decimal("NaN"),
          Decimal("Infinity"), "1000000.01", "0.001", "1.005", 1000001, "", "-", Decimal("1E+7")]:
    bad(v)
p = parse_amount("1.500"); assert p == Decimal("1.5") and p.as_tuple().exponent == -2
assert parse_amount(5).as_tuple().exponent == -2 and parse_amount("+2").as_tuple().exponent == -2
assert parse_amount(Decimal("1E+2")) == 100 and parse_amount("1000000.00") == 1000000
assert parse_amount(Decimal("0.10000000000000000000000000000000000")) == Decimal("0.10")
assert make_invoice(["600000", "400000"])["total"] == "1000000.00"
try: make_invoice(["600000", "400000.01"]); raise AssertionError
except ValueError: pass
before = decimal.getcontext().prec
make_invoice(["1.1"]); assert decimal.getcontext().prec == before
